description: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May launch their travelling motoring show, mixing studio tents, road trips, car tests and increasingly elaborate challenges across Europe, Africa and the Middle East.

s01e01.description: Jeremy, Richard and James launch their new show in California with the Porsche 918, McLaren P1 and Ferrari LaFerrari, while a vast desert opening establishes the new travelling format.

s01e02.description: From Johannesburg, the trio attempt military-style training, Jeremy tests the Aston Martin Vulcan and James is introduced to South Africa's spinning car culture.

s01e03.description: The tent reaches Whitby as Jeremy, Richard and James stage a modern Italian grand tour in an Aston Martin DB11 and Rolls-Royce Dawn, with James arriving in a less welcome choice.

s01e04.description: Jeremy compares the Porsche 911 GT3 RS with the BMW M4 GTS while all three presenters try to build environmentally friendly cars from sustainable materials.

s01e05.description: In Morocco, the trio compare lightweight sports cars including the Alfa Romeo 4C Spider, Mazda MX-5 and Zenos E10, then turn a traditional board game into something involving actual cars.

s01e06.description: Inside the Arctic Circle, Jeremy and Richard compare the Mustang V8 and Focus RS while James recounts Ford and Ferrari's endurance-racing battle and the trio investigate Christmas gifts.

s01e07.description: The trio cross Namibia in personally modified beach buggies, beginning an increasingly difficult desert journey intended to prove the vehicles are better than their old boss ever claimed.

s01e08.description: The Namibia beach-buggy expedition continues through rough tracks, camping, conservation country and an especially improvised river crossing as the trio try to finish their argument on wheels.

s01e09.description: In Stuttgart, James tests the Honda NSX, Jeremy invents an SUV, Richard builds an apocalypse vehicle and the presenters attempt to generate electricity from ordinary activities.

s01e10.description: The presenters attempt to help coral reefs using old car bodies and catastrophically inept boating, while Jeremy tests the Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio.

s01e11.description: Jeremy, Richard and James buy cheap used Maseratis and tour northern France, while Richard tests the Abarth 124 Spider and Jeremy tries to retrofit modern technology to an old car.

s01e12.description: The trio cross central Europe in three luxury SUVs, compare the Jaguar F-Pace, Bentley Bentayga and Range Rover Autobiography, and investigate launch control with their usual restraint.

s01e13.description: In Dubai, Jeremy's Volkswagen Golf GTI faces James's BMW i3, Richard learns drifting, James tries winching and a Bugatti Veyron races a Porsche 918 Spyder.
